body:
1. Security: values sent by the CA can no longer run shell commands. A single
quote in a URL from the CA (finalize, order, cert or account URL) broke out of
the quoting in the saved conf file, and a challenge token or URL holding `#`
could make acme.sh source a local file as a DNS hook. Challenge tokens and
URLs from the CA are now validated. Exploiting either needs a malicious CA or
a broken TLS connection to the CA. Reported by Martin Arlitt and Srini
Seethapathy (Corelight).
2. `--insecure` now applies to the current run only and is no longer saved to
account.conf. A value saved by an older version is ignored and removed; see the
wiki [Note on --insecure](https://github.com/acmesh-official/acme.sh/wiki/Options-and-Params).
3. Signed requests are retried on transport errors, and wget2 is supported.
4. `--install-cert` can now update the pre/post/renew hooks
([#7346](https://github.com/acmesh-official/acme.sh/pull/7346)).
5. Conf files: a write that changes nothing is skipped, and the file is kept
intact when a write fails
([#7278](https://github.com/acmesh-official/acme.sh/pull/7278)). The email
given on the command line no longer overwrites the one in account.conf.
6. New DNS providers: bergdns.at, MVMNET, Public Internet (dns_pblin), Abion,
PrimeDNS, ConnByte, hosttech, Domain Chief, NameOcean, MizbanCloud, Timeweb
(dns_timeweb_host). Cloudflare supports IDN domains, and Simply.com uses
Bearer auth.
7. New deploy hooks: Nginx Proxy Manager / NPMplus, Redfish BMCs, HP printers
(hp_ews), pfSense (pfREST), Proxmox Mail Gateway. deploy/ssh supports pfx and
stops at the first failed step; synology_dsm can generate 2FA codes from
SYNO_TOTP_SECRET.
8. New notify hook: Healthchecks.io.
9. Docker: set-default, update-account-key, list-profiles and
make-dns-persist-value are exposed as commands.
10. A lot of bug fixes.
